title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired stew from Saudi Arabia, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a large clay or ceramic pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the pitted dates and tagine spice blend; cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and add water if desired; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cover; let cook for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
